description: Defines the VacancyAttachmentModel class for representing recruitment attachment data related to vacancies in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. Implements normalization and serialization features, and maps a RecruitmentAttachment DTO to a schema for API responses.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class representing recruitment vacancy attachment data for API serialization, utilizing traits for normalization and implementing the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a RecruitmentAttachment DTO, setting entity data, filters, and attribute mappings for serialization.
